cases.title: The Missing Three
cases.presentation: End of a 38-patient bus crash. Tags issued: 38. Transport log: 33 transported. Released on scene: 1. Dead: 1. Hospitals report receiving 31.
cases.question: What now?
options: A: Do not terminate: 3 tagged patients unaccounted on scene and 2 transported patients not found at hospitals — re-sweep the scene, check the transport log against hospitals, search for self-evacuees.
C: Close the incident — close enough.
cases.explanation: 38 − (33 + 1 + 1) = 3 missing on scene, and 33 − 31 = 2 missing in the hospital system. Reconciliation finds them.

cases.title: After the Night
cases.presentation: Two days after a nightclub fire with multiple deaths, your manager proposes a mandatory 3-hour session where every crew member must describe their worst moments in detail.
cases.question: Best recommendation?
options: A: Replace it with Psychological First Aid, voluntary peer support, practical help, and follow-up checks; refer anyone with persistent or severe symptoms.
B: Support it — talking always helps.
C: Give everyone a week off and no contact.
cases.explanation: Mandatory single-session debriefing is not recommended. PFA principles and voluntary, ongoing support are evidence-informed.
